entries.424f3044f1d71b9e: This is a single-segment business that manufactures in vitro diagnostic drugs and other products, centered on antigen test kits for clinical testing of infectious diseases, and sells them mainly in Japan and also overseas. Its main product is the “Immunoace®” series of immunochromatographic antigen test kits, and it has 3 sites: the Kamijima headquarters and plant, the Shimizu-cho Office (R&D Center), and the Mount Fuji Mishima Plant (operations started in February 2026).
entries.4d14151bc58c1b2b: Under its medium-term management plan, the company has set the vision of “Solving social issues with diagnostic technology, data and AI” and is pursuing five strategies: strengthening infectious disease antigen testing, introducing new POCT, expanding new testing platforms such as contract testing and SaMD, building data and AI infrastructure, and expanding overseas business. It positions infectious disease POCT as an important business foundation and states that it will strengthen its production system centered on the Fujisan Mishima Plant and automate its manufacturing and testing lines.

entries.6cc314e66d960ff8: The company has a single segment, the in vitro diagnostic pharmaceuticals business. Of revenue of ¥14,369 million for the fiscal year ended June 2026, domestic revenue accounted for the large majority at ¥13,890 million, while exports were limited to ¥478 million. Sales are mainly made through pharmaceutical wholesalers, and sales to the Suzuken Group, its main customer, account for 69.7% of the total, a structure with a high concentration of sales customers.
